_comment: Mission-control notes fixture. Conforms to canon/blinker-domain.json `note` _TODO stub: { id, contact_id, opportunity_id?, body, author_id, author_persona, created_at, updated_at, edited_at? }. Promote into canon `note` block when a second app needs notes.

notes.body: Spoke briefly — wants the Bumper-to-Bumper plan. Will compare against extended powertrain. Asked to read agreement before signing.
Sent capture link. Consumer opened it within 4 minutes — good signal.
Lead also asked about refi on the RAV4. Started a refi opportunity in parallel.
Daughter (Tasha Brooks) shares the address — clustered into household. Tasha is do-not-call; reach Maria first.
Quoted on the Pilot. Coverage looked too pricey at first; switched to a tier-down plan.
Auto-insurance referral sent via Embedded Insurance link. Spanish-language preferred, opted-out of marketing email.
Has a work email — primary is personal. He prefers texts to calls.
Fleet customer — pricing reviewed against fleet rate card. Card decline on first payment attempt; followed up via SMS.
Payment plan past due — second decline today. Will call tomorrow morning, before the cancellation window closes.
Owner of an HVAC fleet (8 vehicles total). Two more F-150s likely to come in over the next quarter.
Manager flagged for a save-the-deal review. Decline retry scheduled for tomorrow 8am PT.
Agreement signed. Awaiting system remit.
Renter (Brooklyn). Subaru is paid off — straightforward VSC sale.
Customer asked about cancellation policy. Walked through the 30-day full-refund window.
Working — Equinox refi pending pay stub upload. Customer is do-not-call, communicate via email/portal only.
Lives at her mother's address (Maria Alvarez). Household-clustered.
Sent reminder email re: pay stub upload. Will follow up after 7 days if no response.
Refi funded. Tesla Model Y — clean credit profile, locked in a 4.49% rate.
Asked for a follow-up call about VSC for the Model Y in Q3. Calendar reminder added.
Excellent customer experience — referred a colleague. Worth re-engaging on cross-sell.
Quote in hand — $1,842/6mo via Embedded Insurance. Wants to call husband before deciding.
Spanish-language preferred. Devon handed off the EI agent dashboard explanation in Spanish.
Deadline 2026-05-06 — current policy expires. Must close by then or lose the savings story.
Customer doesn't know the VIN — typed YMMT manually (2016 Ford Explorer, XLT). Need to decode against VIN-less tier-table before quoting.
Will text customer the VIN-locator instructions (windshield + door jamb) so we can re-decode for accurate plan eligibility.
Quoted at default tier — customer didn't have current mileage handy. Need to capture before sending package; mileage gates plan eligibility past 100k.
Customer confirmed Bumper-to-Bumper plan over the phone. Booked for collection of signature + billing details. Setup ACH from primary checking.
Sent payment authorization link. Customer will sign and submit billing this evening. Follow up tomorrow morning if status hasn't moved to Payment Success.
Hybrid Highlander — financed, ~50% paid down. Owner is CTO at a startup, asked technical questions about coverage transferability if traded.
Self-reported FICO 742, $98k AGI W-2. Audi Q5 financed at 7.1% APR through dealer F&I — strong refi candidate. Advancing to housing/employment step.
Customer paused mid-wizard to check payoff balance with current lender. Should resume soon — leave at Self Reported Credit until they confirm payoff.
Quote viewed — $1,124/6mo via Embedded Insurance. ~$340 savings vs current carrier (GEICO). Customer hasn't bound yet; follow up today.
NYC renter, financed XC60 — pricing tighter than expected because of zip code. Worth pitching the savings story early in the call.
Policy bound through Embedded Insurance — Liberty Mutual carrier. Closed clean. Owner has paid-off 4Runner; great VSC cross-sell candidate next.
Mentioned daughter is buying her first car this summer — flag for follow-up referral.
VSC active on the Explorer — customer very happy. Tacoma is older but might have refi upside if the rate dropped.
Refi declined — debt-to-income ratio too high at the time. Re-engage after Q3 payoff.
Switched from GEICO to Embedded Insurance carrier — saved $290/6mo. Happy with the switch.
Three refi offers returned — best is 4.99% APR from Gravity. Down from 7.4% current. Scheduling walkthrough call.
Customer selected Powertrain Plus for the Tesla. Needs to confirm billing before we send.
Odyssey VSC paid in full — great customer, two more vehicles to pitch.
Quoted $1,680/6mo on the new Accord. Good savings vs current State Farm rate.
Not interested at this time — prefers current lender relationship. Try again if rates drop below 5%.
Consumer reviewed the Ridgeline package. Liked the Bumper-to-Bumper plan, wanted a day to think.
Approved by lender at 6.2% APR — significant savings vs current 9.8%. Moving to pending funding.
Capture completed — existing Progressive policy identified. Savings story is strong (~$420/yr). Generating quote.
Suburban VSC signed — large family vehicle, customer very protective of it. Signed after thorough review.
Spanish-language preferred. Has two vehicles; second (Malibu) too old for standard VSC — noted.
VSC cancelled after payment lapse. Husband of Elena Vasquez — re-engage as a household when her coverage renews.
At identity and consent step — customer paused to verify SSN discrepancy with co-applicant. Should resume tomorrow.
Quoted on the Altima — lower tier due to mileage. Waiting for refi to close before pitching VSC.
Passport VSC remitted — system confirmation pending. Customer was very thorough; read every paragraph of the agreement.
Payment success on the Durango plan. Will get to agreement signing next session.
Three calls, no answer. Left voicemail twice. Try alternate number next week.
All docs signed — pending lender funding. Rate locked at 5.25% APR. Expected 5-7 business days.
Consumer viewed EI quote — $1,240/6mo vs $1,620 current. Strong savings story; haven't heard back yet.
New lead — 2023 Camry, almost new. Need to generate quote. Will follow up same day.
Working status — customer called back after the quote link, had questions about deductible options. Call rescheduled.
2019 Tiguan returned no results — likely age+mileage combo (58k, borderline). Tried extended powertrain tier; still no match. Noted for customer.
Package sent on the Expedition — premium plan. Signature link opened twice. Follow up call needed.
Prequalification submitted via Gravity. Customer has good credit but high LTV on the Expedition. Expecting conditional approval.
New Sentra lead — first-time buyer, financed. Good opportunity for base VSC plan.
Pending cancellation — second payment retry failed. Need to call before the 30-day window. Customer was unreachable last week.
Tucson refi funded at 5.1% — down from 8.9%. Customer ecstatic. Cross-sell IONIQ 6 VSC already in progress.
IONIQ 6 VSC booked — collecting billing. Customer wants ACH not card.
Product agreement signed on the GX 460. Premium bumper-to-bumper. Awaiting payment agreement signature.
VIP customer — sending insurance quote link today as a cross-sell follow-on.
Refi rejected — lender flagged recent hard pull from another application. Advise 90-day wait.
Quote link sent for the RX 350. Good savings potential — current Farmers premium is high for this zip.
Remit error on the F-250 VSC — Stone Eagle returned provider code mismatch. Escalated to support.
Mustang payment overdue 14 days. Third outreach attempt — customer says card was replaced, updating now.
Offer selected — 4.75% APR from Gravity. Customer very organized; submitted all stipulations same day.
Payment failed on Wrangler VSC — card declined on first attempt. SMS sent. Retry tomorrow.
Completing auto loan snapshot step — customer had to locate loan statement. Resuming next session.
Package sent on the Prius Prime. Eco-conscious customer — emphasized zero-deductible EV coverage benefit.
New refi lead on the Civic. Young buyer, financed at 10.2% — strong candidate if income qualifies.
Capture link sent for Traverse. Customer's current policy expires next month — strong motivation to switch.
Waiting on last 2 pay stubs from employer (gig-economy worker, monthly variable income). Advised on doc requirements.
Quote link created for Pathfinder. Spanish-language preferred — sent es-language version.
Quoted on the Pathfinder — mid-tier plan. Will review on same call as insurance quote to streamline.
